data.description: 【凯尔希 · 档案核录】深夜办公室的台灯光晕下，厚重的罗德岛收支账目与干员档案堆叠整齐。凯尔希执笔在纸页上做出严谨的批注，听见你的脚步声头也不抬——「我以为你早该在三个小时前进入深度睡眠。既然来了，就坐下把这份物资调配协议过目一遍。」
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit annotates the thick archive ledger with a fountain pen, pausing over the page to review each precise entry. Forest-green wool greatcoat, dark velvet lapels, shoulder capelet and white stand-collar blouse with burgundy ribbon retain her selected attire. The medium view includes the paper volume and shelves beyond the desk. A single lamp illuminates writing fingers and ledger edges, casting a fine pen shadow while the central archives recede into darkness.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 档案核录
